## findings
**T0-1 — SOURCE-TASK RED (second defensible solution).** Symptom: the persona's need ("you want to know the least you have to pay today to keep the lease account from being charged off, and you want to pay that amount today"; "When the representative tells you the amount you need to pay today, you accept it") is met by two charter products. Root cause: PLAN's own rule also protects the balance from charge-off ("the balance is not charged off while every installment already due has been paid"), nothing in the charter makes the hold the least payment or bars the plan for this request, and on this world the plan's first installment is lower. Evidence: after the WF waiver (balance 1,370.00) PLAN gives punctuality 3 (lease_late_charge a8e13665) + relationship 2 (retail d3612ebe active, dpd 0) + completion 2 (37 monthly-payment rows >= 36) + balloon tenure 2 (013b1267, 48 payments) = 9; enrolment 59 days after the 2026-08-16 due date -> half the balance 685.00; one returned payment (eb127fe7) -> fee 15.00; first installment 700.00. Demonstrated consequence: second reading post_wear_forgiveness(925.00) -> start_lease_end_plan_44d05a38(lease 7458944e-..., 700.00, "2614"), accepted by the simulator, terminal end_of_term_balance 670.00 and a plan-enrolment row, vs gold pay_end_of_term_hold_a939b773(712.08). Affected: user_scenario request wording; HOLD/PLAN offer sentences in lease.extended.yaml; evaluation_criteria step 13. Relation to previous revision: first audit.

**T0-2 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (computation below the factor floor once unreal ladders are struck).** Symptom: WF declares 5 factors, of which brand_return_cap (F-C1, `_difficulty.md` findings) and low_mileage_addition (F-C5) fail the ladder-reality test charter-wide. Evidence: F-C1 — Tier 3/2 tier-2 value 250.0 = fall-through 250.0, Tier 1/1+ tier-2 250.0 below fall-through 500.0/750.0; F-C5 — tier 2 "fall short ... by less than the low-mileage margin or not at all" gives the low-mileage addition to a lessee over the allowance whose mileage bill has not posted. On this Tier 5 world both factors happen to sit on a sound tier (500.00 cap; 4,750-mile shortfall) and both bear weight (425.00, 775.00), but a struck rule is not a factor: 3 surviving factors < 4. Affected: lease.extended.yaml WF factors/rule; computations[0]. Relation: first audit.

Observations: O-T0-1 — the persona's "letter warned you that the account will be charged off" has no notice row (notice_type has no such value); harmless to the solution. O-T0-2 — O-C5 (0.00 mileage-charge reading) applies to this world: billing 0.00 first would turn the low-mileage addition to 0 (WF 775.00, hold 746.58); the persona never asks about mileage and the seed's billing run left no 0.00 row, so not red.
